dataset.name: Mongolian resected hepatocellular-carcinoma cohort (GSE144269)
dataset.description: Independent Mongolian hepatocellular-carcinoma cohort with resected primary-tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The National Cancer Center in Ulaanbaatar collected paired tumor and adjacent nontumor liver specimens from 76 surgically treated HCC patients in 2015-2016. Seventy patients have a primary-tumor RNA profile and complete positive overall-survival time/status in the authors' commit-pinned analysis repository.

metadata.source_program: National Cancer Center of Mongolia resected HCC cohort
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus plus the authors' commit-pinned GPL-3.0 analysis repository
metadata.library_method: Total bulk RNA sequencing of paired resected tumor and adjacent nontumor liver. The authors retained rows with mean tumor count greater than one, applied limma-voom with quantile normalization and exported log2-scale expression.
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival in days from diagnosis, with death from any cause as the event
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The authors' public patient_sample_metadata.txt defines survival.status as alive=0/dead=1 and survival.time as days from diagnosis. It contains 76 clinical records; all 70 patients with a GEO tumor RNA profile have complete positive OS time/status, while six clinical records without RNA are excluded deterministically.
metadata.sample_selection_note: GEO contains one tumor and one matched adjacent-nontumor profile for each of 70 RNA-sequenced patients. TRACE Explorer retains only the single source-labelled tumor profile and links it to the numeric patient identifier used by the authors' tumor-only expression matrix.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The commit-pinned tumor-only matrix contains 34,234 source rows and 70 patient columns on the authors' voom/quantile-normalized log2 scale. All rows assigned to a case-insensitive duplicated symbol are excluded rather than silently combined, leaving 33,994 analyzable symbols.
metadata.clinical_covariate_note: The public clinical table supplies exact age and sex for 69 RNA-profiled patients. Source sex codes 0 and 1 are mapped explicitly to Female and Male. TNM stage is available for 54 RNA-profiled patients and is preserved when present.
metadata.privacy_note: The GEO record points phenotypic data to dbGaP, while the publication's public GPL-3.0 analysis repository independently exposes the deidentified clinical input used by its survival scripts. TRACE Explorer consumes only that public commit-pinned file, disables source redistribution and does not retrieve controlled dbGaP data.
metadata.overlap_note: This 2015-2016 Mongolian surgical cohort is institutionally and geographically distinct from TCGA-LIHC, ICGC LIRI-JP, SNUH GSE148355, PLANet and the promoted immunotherapy cohort.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms pinned public files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms and the authors' GPL-3.0 repository license remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Resected primary hepatocellular-carcinoma tumor, one bulk RNA profile per patient

expression.label: Author-provided voom quantile-normalized log2 expression
expression.source_unit: Voom log2 expression with quantile normalization
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided Description gene-symbol column in the commit-pinned tumor-only matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All occurrences of 78 case-insensitive duplicated symbols are excluded before canonicalization; the remaining 33,994 symbols are unique and retain source row order.
expression.scale_note: The authors filtered genes by mean tumor count greater than one, ran limma-voom with quantile normalization over the paired tumor/nontumor matrix and supplied the resulting tumor-only log2-scale values. TRACE Explorer applies no additional expression transformation; values are intended only for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause (source survival.status 1 = death; 0 = alive/censored)
